description.text: Introduction: Marketing is committedto offering a practical, industry-connected education. It also ensures that students are up to speed with current and emerging industry trends.Application-oriented teaching at an internationally competitive levelequipsstudents with management, economics and marketing knowledge, and prepares students to adapt to and contribute to various working environments in the global market. Integrated marketing knowledge and broader skills help students solve real-life marketing problems in companies. Students will develop creative thinking, critical thinking, analytical ability, leadership and teamwork ability. Apart from language andcommunicationskills development, professionalswith an inquisitiveminds, independent thinking,positive work attitudes and self-confidence are also emphasized.Diploma AwardedBachelor of economicsInternship and Career DevelopmentThrough 4 years’ specialized study, students will be acquainted with the trade rules and conventions, policys, Chinese social economy situation, the geographical economy the economical pattern and macroscopic economical trend, region economy development of China. They can be engaged in the trade operation, trade management etc, or become administrative personnel and advanced office clerk of companies in China.

duration.text: The Marketing at Shandong Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of Valid passportWith photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of High SchoolGraduation Certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate3. Be in good health condition and at the age of 18-20
